info.title: NHCX - Notification APIs
info.description: NHCX Subscription Service - Beneficiary Service Provider (BSP) integration

post.summary: Subscribe a beneficiary to NHCX notifications (synchronous)
post.description: Receives an encrypted (JWE / RSA-OAEP / A256GCM) subscribe request from a registered BSP. The request body is `{ "payload": "<jwe.compact.string>" }` where the compact JWE carries the NHCX protected headers and the subscribe JSON payload. NHCX decrypts the request with its private key, validates headers and payload, persists the subscription (Last-Linked-Wins per ABHA ID) and returns the subscription state synchronously.

400.description: Validation failed (invalid headers, malformed JWE, bad ABHA, unknown topic, etc.)

401.description: Sender not authorized (missing / invalid bearer token, or sender code not in registry)

403.description: Forbidden - sender code not permitted to subscribe

400.description: Validation failed (invalid headers, malformed JWE, bad ABHA, unknown topic, etc.)

401.description: Sender not authorized (missing / invalid bearer token, or sender code not in registry)

403.description: Forbidden - sender code not permitted to subscribe

JWEPayload.description: Generic JWE-wrapped payload (compact serialization) per RFC-7516

payload.description: JWE compact serialization (5 dot-separated base64url segments)

SubscribeResponse.description: Response from NHCX subscribe API (or BSP-side persistence acknowledgement)

senderid.description: This field contains the payer/insurance company id. This id is generated when the hospital/provider register in hcx system through participant creation system.

receiverid.description: This field contains the provider/hospital id. This id is generated when the hospital/provider register in hcx system through participant creation system.

correlationid.description: This field contains the corelation id. This id is used to track the request generated by provider.
